title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Next-Gen Model Progress: Elon Musk announced Grok 4.7 training is complete with a 3-4 week launch target, xAI released Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0, and Qwen confirmed its 27B model drops this week.
Developer Tooling Expansion: OpenAI delivered native Linux support for ChatGPT Desktop and Codex, while ZCode celebrated reaching 1 million users by resetting coding usage limits.
Model Efficiency Benchmarks: Industry analysis highlighted how 1.5T parameter models match 10T frontier architectures, significantly lowering production inference costs.
Macro & Policy Debates: Commentators discussed rising H-1B visa backlogs affecting 1.2 million high-skilled workers and ongoing risk-management strategies.
Sports & Media Highlights: Harry Kane's Ballon d'Or odds hit a record 60% on prediction markets, while Bayern Munich installed anti-spying privacy screens at training grounds.

items.title: @elonmusk: Grok 4.7 Model Development Timeline
items.body: Elon Musk announced that Grok 4.7 has completed initial training and will ship in 3-4 weeks, promising significant performance upgrades over version 4.6.

items.title: @QwenDevs: Qwen 27B Model Release Update
items.body: The Qwen developer team confirmed that the upcoming Qwen 27B model will launch this week, expanding open-weights options for developers.

items.title: @thsottiaux: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT Desktop Native Linux Release
items.body: OpenAI expanded its desktop ecosystem by shipping native Linux support for Codex and ChatGPT desktop clients, bringing AI coding tools to Linux workstations.

items.title: @SpaceXAI: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 Announcement
items.body: xAI unveiled Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0, introducing enhanced conversational reasoning, lower latency, and higher speech transcription accuracy.

items.title: @jun_song: Frontier AI Model Efficiency & Parameter Scaling Analysis
items.body: AI researcher Jun Song analyzes parameter efficiency across DeepSeek-V4-Pro (1.6T) and Grok-4.6 (1.5T), highlighting how smaller architectures match 10T-parameter models at lower cost.

items.title: @ZixuanLi_: ZCode Hits 1 Million Users & Limit Reset
items.body: ZCode crossed 1 million active users, prompting GLM to reset daily usage quotas across all coding subscription tiers to celebrate the milestone.

items.title: @KeithMcCullough: Macro Investing Blueprint & Process Review
items.body: Macro strategist Keith McCullough published a comprehensive 52-page guide detailing risk-management and portfolio allocation frameworks for volatile markets.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: Bayern Munich Installs Anti-Spying Privacy Screens
items.body: Bayern Munich installed specialized privacy shielding around its Säbener Straße practice facility at manager Vincent Kompany's request to protect tactical sessions.

items.title: @MontyBennett: High-Skilled Immigration & Green Card Backlog Debates
items.body: Analysis of US immigration policy highlights growing backlogs projected to hit 2 million by 2030 for high-skilled H-1B visa holders and tech talent.

items.title: @KalshiSports: Ballon d'Or Odds Spike to 60% for Harry Kane
items.body: Prediction market data on Kalshi shows Harry Kane's implied probability of winning the Ballon d'Or soaring to a record 60% after dominant goalscoring performances.
